name: kira-room
description: SaaS platform for beauty salons and barbershops

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd packages/backend && npm run dev" "cd packages/frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd packages/backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.test: cd packages/backend && npm run test && cd ../frontend && npm run test
scripts.lint: cd packages/backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.lint:fix: cd packages/backend && npm run lint:fix && cd ../frontend && npm run lint:fix
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/.next packages/*/build
scripts.type-check: cd packages/backend && npm run type-check && cd ../frontend && npm run type-check
